Hi Emma — thanks for the attachments, will loop in Finance (cc'd). A couple quick asks so we can move vendor setup forward:

- Please confirm legal entity name exactly as registered and the UK registered address (we need both for our vendor record).
- On the W-8BEN-E: please confirm the chapter 3 status and that the form is signed and dated; we need the beneficial owner declaration filled in.
- If you plan to add VAT on invoices, include your VAT registration number on the invoice header. If you expect reverse-charge, indicate that on the invoice as well.

I attached our standard remittance instructions for ACH/wire so your AP team has the fields they need (Redwood_Remittance_Instructions_ACH-Wire.pdf).

Once we have the signed W-8BEN-E and the VAT cert (if applicable), Finance will stand up the vendor and process payment.

Emma — thanks for the swift turnaround and the signed W-8. A few notes from Redwood Finance:

- The W-8BEN-E you submitted looks complete; we'll run it through our tax screening but based on the entries we expect 0% US withholding to apply provided no undisclosed US ties.
- We still need a banking verification document (bank letter or voided cheque) to complete ACH setup. Can you provide that? If you prefer wire, the remittance instructions Karthik shared have the required fields.
- For VAT: if you indicate reverse-charge on the invoice and provide the VAT number (you did), we will not add UK VAT and will process per reverse-charge. Please add the phrase "Reverse charge — Article 194 VAT Directive" on the invoice if possible to speed AP review.

I'll send a DocuSign onboarding packet for NorthStar to sign (vendor agreement + tax attestation). Please complete that and upload the bank verification. Expected timeline after receiving DocuSign and bank docs: vendor setup within 5-7 business days and payment scheduling.
